unit: points of spread for one starter missing vs his replacement
note: Static market rules of thumb (plan phase 4), checked by personnel.validate_position_values. QB is priced by the starter-vs-backup passer rating gap (NCAA efficiency, season to date); a backup with too few attempts to rate is 'unknown_backup'. Non-QBs are flat per position; the 1 roles (WR1, RB1, CB1) are a team's top player there. status_weight scales a player's value by how sure the absence is. A team's missing total at or above line_mover is a line-mover; below it, it matters at the margin.
